Bas, enough!
If this is how it must be, we hit each other.

With luck, I survive—and he also receives something!

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Careless fool.

He had tricked me. A little extension of his sword point—that was all. His body had stayed exactly where it was.

A lunge, I had decided. On that excellent assumption, I sent my sword swimming through empty air. It only skimmed his breastplate. Damage: nothing.

And then.

　騙された。
　敵手は……太刀先を<ruby>つい<rt>・・</rt></ruby>と、差し伸ばしてきただけ
だった。身体の位置はそのままに。

　敵が突き掛かってきたのだと思い込んで繰り出した
俺の太刀は、むなしくも虚空を泳いでいる。
　敵騎の胸甲を舐めたきり、何の損傷も与えていない。

　そして。
